# Image regeneration list (all four shops)

Prepared 2026-10-14 for the storefront preview. **Don't generate yet:** the image API (fal.ai) is a pending setup item. When it's live, run each "needs regen" prompt, then add the results to the brand's `images.json`/`catalog.json` (replace the current file) and rebuild.

Rules every prompt follows: shirt-sized art on the back, chest marks medium; Runwae uses only forest / ivory / washed black / rust; real marks only (Ridgefield square, Butts Studios C5, provisional typeset Runwae wordmark, GLB hand-lettered mark). No prices, reviews or invented claims.
